mods.name: Seal Paradise
mods.description: Minecraft Mod that adds Seal Paradise to the game! Mod created as a final project for 3rd semester of IT studies.

releases.notes:
Finally I can release the first beta, which satisfies me for this moment.

Of course mod will be updated because I love seals so much.

List of items added:
1. Blocks:
Block of Niko Seal
Snowy Cobblestone
Block of Fish
2. Animals:
Niko the Seal
Yo the Seal
Mizore the Seal
Kyoro the Seal
3. New Dimension - Seal World
4. New Biome - Seal Biome
5. Portal

To enter the Seal World, just get at least 10 blocks of fish (made in crafting table by placing 9 fish on the 3x3 grid), build a portal just like the nether portal and light it up. After entering the world you will be able to see all the beloved seals!
